item.title: ‘Devastated and heartbroken:’ Running community shocked by allegations against ex-Santa Rosa High coach
item.description: The allegations facing Doug Courtemarche have convulsed the North Bay's tight-knit running community and raised questions about what Santa Rosa school officials knew and why they didn't alert people at the time about the felony charge pending against the legendary ex-coach.

item.title: Sonoma Valley Democrats hear from 4th Congressional District incumbent Thompson and his primary challengers
item.description: Mike Thompson, Eric Jones and Trevor Merrell touted their qualifications for the seat Monday, Feb. 9, during an online-only candidates' forum hosted by the regional political organization.

item.title: Conductor queda en estado crítico tras choque a alta velocidad contra edificio de Santa Rosa
item.description: El automóvil se estrelló y rompió al menos tres ventanas que daban a la calle, cortó el lado interior de un poste de electricidad, derribó un árbol pequeño y tumbó dos pilares de un muro de contención de ladrillos, dijo el propietario del edificio.

item.title: Shootings at school and home in northeastern British Columbia leave 10 dead including shooter
item.description: A shooting at a school in British Columbia left eight dead including the suspect, with two more people found dead at a home believed to be connected to the incident, Canadian authorities said Tuesday.

item.title: Napa County supervisors support bill to limit environmental lawsuits against child care centers
item.description: Senate Bill 299 would limit the ability of people to challenge child care centers in residential areas using the California Environmental Quality Act, a hurdle owners of Napa’s Le Petit Elephant Nursery and Preschool overcame last year by settling with neighbors.

item.title: Sonoma County names Sonoma City Manager David Guhin as next county executive
item.description: David Guhin, the current Sonoma city manager and a former longtime Santa Rosa official, steps into the role with significant local government experience — and little time to get settled in before crafting a challenging budget with the county this spring.

item.title: Boys basketball rankings: Windsor moves back up to No. 2 as league tournaments begin
item.description: The final week of the high school basketball regular season has arrived in the North Bay.

item.title: Girls basketball rankings: No changes as league tournaments get underway
item.description: The top seven girls teams stay unchanged this week as those squads finished out league play with a combined record of 16-1.
